description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world—one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
 
We're a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we're looking for passionate people to help us get there.
 
For more information, visit arcadia.io.
 
Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia
Arcadia's petabyte-scale data platform is at the heart of everything the company does; everyone from our external customers to our engineers, from our analysts to our sales team, depends on it. They don't just use it; they build on it. This data platform needs to enable a shared ownership model, so the platform team can scale and internal teams can move fast. This role sets how we build and run it.
 
The role reports directly to the VP of Engineering.
 
What Success Looks Like
The data platform provides building blocks, from catalog and pipelines to databases, queues, and storage, that come pre-wired with connectivity, logging, metrics, tracing, alerts, encryption, access controls, backups, and cost tags—all with sensible defaults.
 
Internal teams own and change their pipelines, environments, alerts, and SLOs. When something breaks, the owning team sees it first, traces it to the root cause, and addresses it themselves. They see their own quality numbers and cloud spend, and act on them. Data platform engineers spend their time building capabilities, not working tickets.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partner with internal teams to prioritize, implement, and roll out features they depend on—from enabling self-service ETL authoring to provisioning new data stores, from establishing data quality metrics to optimizing performance.
  • Evaluate new technologies and architectures, prototype them, and roll them out as new capabilities across the platform.
  • Write a meaningful share of the production code.
  • Work closely with our AWS infrastructure team on the platform's network, compute, and security.
  • Push quality attributes into the platform, especially as AI increases the volume of changes. We need the platform itself to be stable, resilient, performant, and cost-effective. Internal teams that build on it need to be able to configure their own SLIs/SLOs and focus on data quality.
  • Run the platform as an internal product: find what slows teams down, pick the few capabilities worth building, publish the roadmap, and measure adoption, delivery speed, stability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Drive migrations to completion: track usage, automate instead of handing out checklists, push through the final 20%, and sunset legacy systems.
  • Set technical direction, evolve the platform, and coach other engineers through design partnership and review.
  • Building data engineering tooling on top of our internal AI platform.

    • What You'll Bring

  • Deep experience in data engineering—from columnar stores to data lakes, from distributed processing to SQL optimization.
  • Expertise in software engineering—CI/CD, testing, architecture, source control, automation, observability, modularity and reuse, and fluency in Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Modern data stack experience (e.g. data contracts and data products, dbt, Spark, Dagster, Iceberg and Parquet, notebooks and BI, data catalogs and data quality).
  • Strong AWS experience since the platform is built on its network, storage, and compute primitives.
  • Experience building with AI.
  • Reliability you've owned: SLOs, observability, on-call, and incident response.
  • Current, hands-on production coding, the habit of figuring things out (research, spike, deliver), and relentless pragmatism about what's worth building.
  • A track record of driving change across the org.

    • Would Love for You to Have

  • Regulated-data experience (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2 or HITRUST environments).
  • A public voice through talks, writing, or open source.
  • Experience turning a data engineering team into a product-minded platform team complete with processes, stakeholder management, and a roadmap.
  • Experience building platform support that scales: support tiers, office hours, docs, shared ownership principles, escalation processes, and developer advocacy.
  • No healthcare background required.

    • What You'll Get

  • The opportunity to shape Arcadia's data platform and its direction for years to come.
  • Direct influence on how Arcadia's engineering org works on a daily basis through tooling, patterns, and standards.
  • Remote-first across the US, with in-person hubs growing in Boston, DC, and NYC.
  • A flexible culture with personality and heart, named a Built In 2026 Best Place to Work.
  • Work that shows up in patients' lives.
    • About Arcadia
    Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.

    Protect Yourself
    If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781) 202-3600 and select option 3. For more information, visit our website.

    This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI under Arcadia's custodianship as well as Arcadia Intellectual Properties.  For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.
